description: The spec's own locale example: Name plus sr_YU, sr@Latn and sr postfixes
notes: Spec 5 states that for LC_MESSAGES=sr_YU@Latn 'the value of the Name keyed by sr_YU is used', because the ladder is lang_COUNTRY@MODIFIER, lang_COUNTRY, lang@MODIFIER, lang. Also checks that asking for plain 'sr' must not pick up Name[sr@Latn].
